methods.name: SAM-CFFNet (SAM-based cross-feature fusion network)
methods.summary: SAM-CFFNet is an end-to-end semantic segmentation network that uses a frozen SAM image encoder (IEViT) to extract multi-level features, which are then processed by a custom cross-feature fusion decoder (CFFD). The CFFD integrates multi-scale features using a cross-feature fusion module (CFFM), a shallow feature extractor (SFE) for texture details, and a Bottle ASPP module for background context.
methods.verbatim: In this study, we propose the SAM-based cross-feature fusion network (SAM-CFFNet)... The code for this experiment has been posted at: https://github.com/JunchuanYu/SAM-CFFNet (accessed on 20 May 2024).

code_links.name: SAM-CFFNet: SAM-based cross-feature fusion network for landslide identification
code_links.summary: Custom deep learning code implementing the proposed SAM-CFFNet model, which uses SAM's image encoder with a cross-feature fusion decoder for high-precision landslide segmentation.
